from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u001/system/state/workspace/programs/task-9c72b357.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    centers = []
    for r in range(1, h-1):
        for c in range(1, w-1):
            if (grid[r][c-1] == 2 and grid[r][c+1] == 2 and
                grid[r-1][c] == 2 and grid[r+1][c] == 2):
                centers.append((r,c))
    for i, (r1,c1) in enumerate(centers):
        for r2,c2 in centers[i+1:]:
            if r1 == r2:
                for c in range(min(c1,c2)+1, max(c1,c2)):
                    if out[r1][c] == 0: out[r1][c] = 1
            elif c1 == c2:
                for r in range(min(r1,r2)+1, max(r1,r2)):
                    if out[r][c1] == 0: out[r][c1] = 1
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
from importlib.machinery import SourceFileLoader
m=SourceFileLoader('taskprog',str(p)).load_module()
g=[[0]*15 for _ in range(9)]
for r,c in [(1,2),(2,1),(2,3),(3,2),(3,7),(4,6),(4,8),(5,7),(5,2),(6,1),(6,3),(7,2),(5,10),(6,9),(6,11),(7,10)]:g[r][c]=2
print(m.transform(g))
